messages:
OncallBot: :rotating_light: Alert: p99 streaming decode latency spike detected in us-west-2 TRT pool. p99 climbed from ~120ms to ~480ms in the last 8m. Auto-escalating to #eng-oncall. (alert=inc-4820001)
Anika: seeing it on the dashboard too — p95 ~2x, p99 ~4x. Mostly long-seq (>1024) requests hitting /chat/stream and /chat/generate. :eyes:
Diego: traces point to repeated kernel preempt logs on TRT8 hosts, started right after kernel rollout rtv4-20260210-8b2f.
Jen (runtime): yep, that rollout enabled a new FlashAttention compile path via compiler flags: `-DFAST_FLASH_PATH=1` and `-Ofast-kernel`. Could be interacting badly with TRT8 sparse kernels.
Alex (SRE): quick customer impact: ~3.7% of requests have p99 > 300ms. Top impacted customers by volume: acme-inc, pixly, docsmith. Opened INC-4820001 and linked the customer pages.
Maya: acme reported stream timeouts and retries — they hit their client-side 30s limit. Adding them to incident comms.
Diego: pulled /var/log/runtime/decode.log from trt8-3, snippet:
```
E 10:12:03 kernel_preempt: ctx-switch stall 0x7fbf.. count=6
W 10:12:04 flash_attn: fallback to generic path
D 10:12:04 decode: kv cache miss, recompile fallback
```
Jen (runtime): that `fallback to generic path` is the issue — optimized FlashAttention kernel is dropping out mid-stream and we fall back to slower generic kernels, causing severe tail latency. Likely a mismatch between the new compile-time path and the TRT8 driver/kernel combo.
Paolo (ops-bot): Deploybot: rollback job queued -> target kernel-rtv3 (previous stable). Command: `deployctl rollout --target kernel-rtv3 --pool trt8 --tag stable`. ETA ~6m. :gear:
Anika: suggestion — steer new long-seq requests away from trt8 to minimize further customer impact while rollback proceeds.
Alex (SRE): applied route rule: `traffic-split chat/stream: trt8=0.0, trt7=0.6, qnt=0.4`. Observed immediate improvement for newly routed traffic.
Diego: perf sanity check: routed traffic p95 back near baseline. Existing in-flight sessions pinned to trt8 still show elevated p99.
Jen (runtime): mitigation plan: 1) complete kernel rollback, 2) remove FAST_FLASH_PATH flag from rtv4 builds and re-run microbenchmarks across sequence lengths, 3) run an extended 60m canary before re-enabling.
Maya: I'll notify affected customers (acme, pixly, docsmith) and recommend retry/backoff. Capturing their logs for postmortem.
Alex (SRE): rollback progress: 3/5 trt8 nodes updated, no failures. Pager if rollback not done by +15m.
Anika: monitoring targets: GPU util, KV cache miss rate, and driver RPC errors. If KV miss spikes we may need to warm caches.
Diego: one trt8 node reported a kernel OOM during upgrade; nvdriver rpc timeout in core dump. Filed infra ticket INF-4820002 for followup.
Jen (runtime): short-term tweak: bump streaming RPC timeout from 30s -> 45s for affected routes to reduce client timeouts during the fallback window. Low risk and reversible.
Alex (SRE): feature flag rollout done: `ff.toggle stream_rpc_timeout +15s` for chat/* routes. Documented in ops log. :white_check_mark:
OncallBot: rollback complete on trt8 pool. Nodes now on kernel-rtv3. Re-evaluating SLOs.
Anika: SLO query: p95 back to baseline cluster-wide, p99 down from ~480ms -> ~140ms.
Maya: customers confirmed fewer retries. Added customer-impact notes to INC-4820001.
Diego: next steps: reproduce locally with rtv4 + FAST_FLASH_PATH to capture why the FlashAttention path falls back mid-stream. Hypothesis: alignment/warp-size edge-case for sequences not multiple of block size.
Jen (runtime): creating RT-482002: reproduce + unit test for mid-stream kernel fallback, add guard to disable FAST_FLASH_PATH for TRT8 driver versions >= X.Y.Z, and add preflight checks for future compiler flags.
Alex (SRE): handoff checklist for night oncall:
- Monitor p95/p99 for chat/stream and chat/generate (5m alert windows)
- Watch rollback health and KV cache miss rate
- Continue collecting decode logs (s3 prefix inc-4820001/logs/)
- If p99 > 250ms for >15m escalate to eng-runtime
Anika: I'll take the postmortem write-up. Initial blameless notes: risky compiler flag + kernel/driver mismatch caused mid-stream fallback -> tail latency spike. Action items: stronger preflight (microbench matrix), longer canary, automated rollback gating on p99.
Maya: handing off to night shift @Liam. Liam, ping here when you take it.
Liam: taking handoff. Monitoring 00:00-08:00 PST. Will update if I see regressions. :thumbsup:
OncallBot: Incident INC-4820001 moved to monitoring. Handoff complete.
